name: agentforge
description: Agentic Coding Desktop for real-world engineering projects.

scripts.build: tsc -b packages/core packages/runtime packages/tools packages/ui apps/desktop
scripts.dev: pnpm build && pnpm link:workspaces && pnpm --filter @agentforge/desktop dev
scripts.test: pnpm build && pnpm link:workspaces && node --test tests/*.test.mjs
scripts.typecheck: tsc -b packages/core packages/runtime packages/tools packages/ui apps/desktop --pretty false
